review: One independent condition-label-masked calibration reviewer applies unchanged110feature definitions to all120shuffled outputs; estimates are exploratory calibration, not confirmatory. Preserve original uncertainty/evidence and all failures.
uncertainty: For selection only, uncertain is conservatively counted0 for each persona feature and for coherence; do not change original review labels. Missing/unrated outputs block selection. Hard-loop outputs have coherence0.

selection.qualifying_unit: Any of the five persona features confidently positive on at least one of the four calibration prompts; raw feature positives are not erased by incoherence, while global coherence is a separate gate.
selection.qualifying_multiplier: At least4 of10 qualifying units, at least36 of40 coherent replies (90%), and at least2 distinct persona-feature types confidently observed anywhere among the40replies.
selection.primary: Choose the lowest qualifying multiplier in [1.0,1.5,2.0].
selection.fallback: If none qualifies, among multipliers with at least36of40coherent replies choose the one with most qualifying units; tie chooses lower multiplier. Mark fallback and unmet gates explicitly; do not describe this as having met the primary persona gate. Diagnostic selection only: if the primary gate is unmet, DO NOT run the confirmatory benchmark even if a coherent fallback multiplier is recorded.
selection.stop: If no multiplier has at least36of40coherent replies, stop confirmatory study as feasibility failure. Do not add doses/prompts/components or select individual unit doses.
selection.scope: Use ONE selected multiplier globally for all later111single/pairconditions; no per-coordinate, sign, prompt or pair tuning.
selection.confirmatory_gate: Proceed to fresh forecasts/validation ONLY when a multiplier meets all three primary gates. Fallback and no-coherent-dose modes are feasibility failures for confirmatory continuation.

scope_limitations: Dose search is explicitly exploratory and conditioned on these ten known units; calibration does not estimate validation generalization.
No baseline is added to these120replies: this selects visible feature activity and coherence, not intervention effect versus unsteered behavior. Later validation needs baseline.
Persona types may occur in different replies; gate does not require joint catgirl identity, meow+identity, or coherent task success.
Calibration feature presence may coexist with hijacking; relevance is retained but not a selection gate.
Subsequent confirmation must use fresh prompts and independently locked fresh forecasts AFTER the global multiplier is frozen, with no calibration outputs supplied to forecasters.
If fallback has little/no persona activity, report feasibility weakness; do not hide it behind dose selection.
Original BF16 model and published additive convention retained; dose magnitudes may exceed natural activation range.
publication: Keep raw calibration transcripts local with hashes. Publish compact plan, selection counts/rule, chosen multiplier or feasibility failure, and later independently frozen methods/results.
